title: Terraform DLP web rule and email profile resources
aliases: dlp web rule url category val

prose.text: DLP web rules relate to URL categories and to each other in provider-specific ways. {{category-by-val}} How the category side is defined: [[zia.terraform.url-categories]].

checks.do: Whether a DLP rule's URL category is referenced by `val`, not by name.
Whether a destroy plan removes a parent DLP rule, which takes its sub-rules with it.

category-by-val.statement: The DLP web rule documentation examples reference URL categories through the category's numeric `val` attribute.

parent-destroy-removes-subrules.statement: Destroying a parent DLP web rule also destroys all its sub-rules.

quotes: Destroying a parent rule will also destroy all sub-rules.

subrules-separate-resources.statement: Exception (sub-) rules are separate `zia_dlp_web_rules` resources that set `parent_rule` to the parent's numeric rule ID; the parent's `sub_rules` attribute is computed after apply.

quotes: The parent’s `sub_rules` attribute is **computed** after apply

email-profile-early-access.statement: `zia_email_profile` is documented as an Early Access feature.
